mutations.name: a capped compare file list clears the commits
kills: behindMain against the deploy pacer's path filter counts the commits when GitHub capped the file list

mutations.name: an empty compare file list clears the commits
kills: behindMain against the deploy pacer's path filter counts the commits when the compare carries no file list

mutations.name: a moved file's old path is dropped from the compare read
kills: behindMain against the deploy pacer's path filter asks gh for each moved file's old path and marks a missing list

mutations.name: an unreadable closure clears the commits
kills: behindMain against the deploy pacer's path filter counts the commits when the closure cannot be read
